# Independent R audit references

Generated by `scripts/check_audit_references.R` using R 4.1.0, coda 0.19-4.1,
and the authors' sAIC 1.0.1 package. The script records the model definitions
and convergence settings. Its external package sources are not vendored here.

`raftery-chain.csv` was generated with NumPy `default_rng(451)`: 5,000 standard
normal innovations in three columns. Column one is iid. Columns two and three
follow AR(1) recursions with coefficients 0.8 and -0.45. R diagnostics use
q = 0.025, 0.5, 0.975; r = 0.02; s = 0.95; and existing sample spacing 1 or 2.
The R dependence ratio is reported to three significant digits.

The remaining data and results are deterministic expressions in the R script.
AIC cases include both a zero and nonzero supplied intercept. OLS AIC includes
the estimated error variance. GLM Wald bounds use the normal 0.975 quantile.
Weibull references include right-censoring, density, survival, mean, variance,
and survival-deviance residuals.
